_comment: Canonical cc2cc connection config (~/.cc2cc/connections.json). Supersedes the flat relay.json — legacy relay.json is still read and mapped into this same shape. 'self' identifies this instance; 'connections' lists hubs to dial (type:server) and is extensible to peers. The active hub is the first enabled type:server entry. Encryption is independent of transport (E2E AES); the hub only ever sees ciphertext.

connections._url_note: Full base URL — scheme + host + optional path prefix. The client appends /api/* (e.g. .../bridge/cc2cc/api/register); the reverse proxy rewrites /bridge/cc2cc/api/* -> /api/* on the hub's localhost bind. HTTPS terminates at the proxy. Trailing slashes are stripped automatically.
